gap.title: On a plane of order q, every fan-in-two AND/OR circuit for incidence can be replaced by a read-1 one with at most as many gates
gap.statement: ∀ (q N : ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin N → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), 2 ≤ q → N = q ^ 2 + q + 1 → (∀ l : Fin N, (Finset.univ.filter (fun p => I p l)).card = q + 1) → (∀ p p' : Fin N, p ≠ p' → ∃! l : Fin N, I p l ∧ I p' l) → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (N + N) C → (∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) C z = decide (∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l) = true)) → ∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (N + N) D ∧ (∀ y : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) D y = decide (∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ y (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ y (Fin.natAdd N l) = true)) ∧ D.size ≤ C.size ∧ PEqualNP.ReadK.IsReadK (N + N) D 1
gap.unlocks: The stronger form the small cases allow: some no-larger circuit reads each point and line of a pair once.
gap.context: SKETCH: No proof is expected here in one piece: propose a cut into smaller statements. One move is known to keep size and function: a wire that is below the function and feeds an OR gate can be moved to the output (delete that OR, add one OR at the top). Repeating it ends with a circuit that is an OR of blocks, no wire inside a block being below the function. The open part is a least circuit whose blocks are not single stars: such a block must be shown to cost at least a star cover of the edges it accepts. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.
